nodes.question: Why is there a lack of extensive research on MPs in mangroves compared to plastic waste?
nodes.answer: Most studies have focused primarily on plastic waste, while research on microplastics in mangroves is still in its infancy.

nodes.question: What research fields are represented by the various departments mentioned in the affiliations?
nodes.answer: The research fields include water pollution research, textile technology, environmental engineering, botany and microbiology, and physics.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the primary objective of the study conducted by Ricky et al.?
nodes.answer: The primary objective of the study is to evaluate the impacts of DEET on the biochemical composition of Chlorella vulgaris post-treatment, in order to understand the phycoremediation potential of the algal species relative to its tolerance limit.
